lines.text: Saul proclaimed in the synagogues that Jesus is the Son of God and confounded the Jews in Damascus.
After many days the Jews plotted to kill Saul, so his disciples lowered him in a basket through a window.
In Jerusalem the disciples feared Saul, but Barnabas brought him to the priests and described how he saw the Lord.
Saul spoke boldly and debated the Grecian Jews, who tried to kill him, so he was sent to Antioch.
The church throughout Judea, Galilee, and Samaria had peace and grew in strength and numbers.
